answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the river queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 661 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the forge. The plume index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 265 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
